card.name: Dates and numbers in history and religion
card.fires_on: Spaces and digits just before a year or figure, and nearby linking words, in web text about religion, history or science. Often fires before a date such as 400 B.C.E. or 1969.

modes.label: Before a year or number
modes.description: A space or leading digit right where a year or percentage is about to be written.
modes.example: Shinto has been the religion of Japan since<< >>400 B.C.E. Buddhism

modes.label: Linking words in religious history
modes.description: Small words like in, from or ordered in passages on mosques, scripts or biblical events.
modes.example: It is read<< from>> left to right,
